stories.title: NVIDIA announces a leadership transition
stories.date_evidence: Public announcement November 12; SEC says board accepted resignation November 11. Both primary documents fully read via urllib.
stories.caveats: Do not discuss unverified personal allegations, predict stock movements or claim transition occurred November12.
stories.narration: NVIDIA announced a major leadership change today. Jensen Huang has resigned as president, chief executive and a director. Finance chief Colette Kress is serving as interim chief executive while keeping her existing role, and the board is searching for a permanent successor. Harvey Jones becomes board chair. There is an important date distinction: the company announced the transition on November twelfth, while its regulatory filing says the board accepted the resignation on November eleventh. NVIDIA says it expects operations and its product roadmap to continue without interruption. That is the company's expectation, not an independently verified outcome.

stories.title: Google introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen
stories.date_evidence: Primary article dated November12 and fully read via urllib; raw extracted text saved gemini.txt.
stories.caveats: Performance claims are vendor benchmarks, not our testing. Avoid unsupported model ranking.
stories.narration: Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen today, positioning it as a faster execution model for coding and agent workflows. It is available through AI Studio and the Gemini API, with a one million token context window. Published API pricing is one dollar fifty per million input tokens and seven dollars fifty per million output tokens. Google also introduced Orchestrator in Antigravity, which can switch models within a session. The practical question is whether splitting difficult reasoning from routine execution lowers your own costs without losing quality. Google's benchmark results suggest that direction, but we have not independently tested those performance claims.

stories.title: Google intelligent eyewear opens for preorder
stories.date_evidence: November12 primary article fully read via urllib; eyewear.txt saved. Preorder November12; retail availability December10.
stories.caveats: Manufacturer feature/battery claims, no hands-on test. Availability/account/device eligibility restrictions. Not a launch/shipping today.
stories.narration: Google's new intelligent eyewear collections opened for preorder today. The frames were developed with Gentle Monster, Warby Parker and Samsung, and put hands-free Gemini assistance alongside a camera and open-ear audio. Warby Parker styles start at three hundred ninety-five dollars; Gentle Monster's collection starts at four hundred forty-nine. stories.title: OpenAI presents Daybreak defense tools
stories.date_evidence: OpenAI homepage identifies Daybreak event November12; event hub links both product pages, fully read.
stories.caveats: Red Team early access, not universally available; authorized systems only; patches need engineer review and tests.
stories.narration: OpenAI's Daybreak announcements focus on moving from security findings to fixes. Defense Factory uses agents to investigate reported vulnerabilities and prepare patches, with engineers reviewing and testing before a merge. Daybreak Red Team is presented as an early-access service for testing web applications, confirming vulnerabilities and checking whether a patch blocks an exploit. OpenAI describes scope controls and isolated environments for those assessments. The distinction matters: finding suspicious code is not the same as proving a vulnerability, and generating a patch is not proof that it is safe. These are vendor-described tools for authorized security work, not a replacement for review.

stories.title: Cloudflare open-sources Kitesurf
stories.caveats: Experimental, incomplete compatibility; hosted use requires paidWorkers; no built-in authentication. Do not claim Chromium compatibility or benchmark superiority.
stories.narration: Cloudflare made Kitesurf open source today under the Apache two point zero license. It is a browser engine aimed at AI agents that runs on Workers, handling HTML, CSS and page JavaScript without a browser container. Support for the Chrome DevTools Protocol lets clients such as Puppeteer connect. That makes it interesting for developers exploring agent browsing, but there are important limits. Cloudflare calls Kitesurf experimental and says standards support and rendering fidelity are still being improved. Hosting it on Cloudflare requires a paid Workers plan, and deployments need their own authentication layer. Open source does not mean production-ready or free hosting.

stories.title: Cloudflare AI Search adds D1 beta support
stories.caveats: Beta; scheduled sync not instantaneous; read-only source query not permission guarantee; practical examples hypothetical.
stories.narration: Cloudflare AI Search can now use D1 databases as a source, in beta. Developers provide a read-only query, and the service turns each returned row into a separate indexed document. Scheduled synchronization tracks added, changed and removed rows. Instances can be created through the dashboard, REST API or Workers binding. For a site with articles or help content already stored in D1, that could reduce the work of building a separate search ingestion pipeline. That is a possible use case, not a tested result here. The feature is beta, and scheduled synchronization should not be confused with instant updates.

stories.title: Cloudflare changes Tunnel URL normalization
stories.date_evidence: November12 entry fully read on product changelog. cloudflared2026.11.0 change; future default February8 2027.
stories.caveats: Off by default now; only rules requiringAccessvalidation affected; origin path unchanged. Do not suggest unreviewed production security changes.
stories.narration: Cloudflare has a concrete testing task for Tunnel administrators. Version twenty twenty-six point eleven extends URL normalization to semicolon-delimited path parameters before ingress rules are matched. The change concerns tunnels with rules requiring Cloudflare Access validation; the path forwarded to the origin stays unchanged. Normalization is currently off by default. Cloudflare now plans to enable it by default in new releases starting February eighth, twenty twenty-seven, later than its previously announced date. The useful next step is to test path-based routing before that deadline, especially semicolon-containing paths. Do not assume your application routes are unaffected or change a production configuration without testing.

stories.title: GitHub strengthens secret-scanning workflows
stories.date_evidence: First two primary changelogs dated November12; third October20 explicitly effectiveNovember12; all fully read.
stories.caveats: Public-monitoring feature requires EnterpriseCloud plus SecretProtection/AdvancedSecurity. Detection not guaranteedrevocation; auditmigration announcedearlier.
stories.narration: GitHub's security updates today include detection for Cloudflare Access service tokens and direct links to individual public-monitoring alerts. Those links can help eligible enterprise teams share a finding without making colleagues hunt through a list. Public monitoring requires GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Secret Protection or Advanced Security. There is also a migration taking effect today that was announced earlier: certain secret-scanning audit events change their business field from the enterprise display name to its slug. Integrations filtering on the old name need attention; GitHub recommends accepting both formats or using the unchanged numeric business identifier. Detection still does not replace credential rotation.

stories.title: Vindictus: Defying Fate announced for PS5
stories.date_evidence: November12 primary article by Nexon lead director explicitly announcesPS5 today; title says nextyear=2027.
stories.caveats: Announcement, not released; multiplayer being prepared, not promise of launchfeature; no exact launch date confirmed.
stories.narration: For gaming, Nexon announced today that Vindictus: Defying Fate is coming to PlayStation Five next year. The action role-playing game takes place in a fantasy world inspired by Celtic mythology and gives different heroes distinct combat styles. The developer describes dodging, shield counters and timing-heavy encounters rather than one identical moveset for every character. Its PlayStation Store wishlist page is live. This is a platform announcement for twenty twenty-seven, not a release today. The team also says it is preparing multiplayer content, but that should not be treated as a confirmed launch feature or a promise of a particular release date.

stories.title: Amazon updates Future Ready training plans
stories.date_evidence: Original article October23 2025; explicitly updatedNovember12 2026, homepage identifiesone-yearupdate. Fullyread.
stories.caveats: Do not call existing$2.5B/$1B newtoday; participation/benefits vendorreported; eligibilityvaries; page countryfootnote incomplete versusbody avoid list.
stories.narration: Amazon published a one-year update on its Future Ready twenty thirty training initiative today. This is not a newly announced two point five billion dollar fund: the company introduced that commitment in twenty twenty-five. Today's update describes education pathways in areas including cybersecurity, manufacturing and semiconductors, plus professional credentials with university partners. Amazon says Career Choice has had more than five hundred thousand participants since twenty twelve. For people considering a career change, the useful part is checking which specific courses and benefits they qualify for. Company participation figures are not evidence that every participant obtained a new job or higher pay.
